# Rost: documentation

Rost started as a design system for my own needs and grew into a product of its own. Today it serves products across different industries. Start here.

| Read | For |
|---|---|
| [How a contract works](CONTRACT.md) | What's in one, how it grows up, when it's done, how to add one |
| [Components](#catalogue) | A page per component: how to use it, props, parts, tokens, where code differs |
| [rost.build](https://rost.build) | Every component, live where it's built, with every value of every variant |
| [Token coverage](TOKENS.md) | Why each value has a token or doesn't |
| [Accessibility](ACCESSIBILITY.md) | Where the components stand against WCAG 2.1 AA, in both themes |
| [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) | What I'm doing next |
| [Release notes](CHANGELOG.md) | What changed in each release |

**79** contracts, **5** stable. **79** have guidance, and I've signed off **32** of those.

## Health

What needs attention. It's built from the contracts, so it's only as fresh as the last `npm run docs`.

### Still open from Figma

- [Menu effect](components/effect-menu.md)

### Differences nobody has taken to design yet

- [Button](components/button.md): Figma has Button twice: the set at 20:14 (PillButton, with a `leading` icon slot that's off by default) and the one at 39:38 (Button, label only)
- [Button](components/button.md) in the portfolio site: On a phone the homepage hero's two Buttons stretch to the full width of the column
- [Chip](components/chips.md) in the portfolio site: Drawn as a `<span>` (`as="span"`) in the case-study meta, with no hover, press or cursor
- [Hero Media](components/hero-media.md): The artwork is dimmed with `opacity/medium` (0.48) on a #171717 frame
- [Hero Media](components/hero-media.md) in the portfolio site: Each case study makes the hero full-bleed (`width: 100vw`, negative margin) and brings its own artwork, sized and positioned for that collage
- [InlineBanner](components/inline-banner.md) in the portfolio site: A client case study's disclaimer is a whole sentence, so on a narrow screen its label wraps and sits left-aligned instead of staying on one centred line
- [InlineBanner](components/inline-banner.md) in the accounting app: Every banner's label wraps and sits left-aligned on a narrow screen, instead of staying on one centred line
- [Projects](components/projects.md) in the portfolio site: The last row in the Work list has no line at rest; hover and press still draw it
- [Projects](components/projects.md) in the portfolio site: Under 768px the Work list hides the right side (industry, type and period), and a name too long for the row wraps instead of staying on one line
- [Testimonials](components/testimonials.md) in the portfolio site: The open quote is `non-interactive/foreground/tertiary`, with key phrases in `non-interactive/foreground/primary`
- [Testimonials](components/testimonials.md) in the portfolio site: Under 768px the name and job line wrap instead of staying on one line
- [Testimonials](components/testimonials.md) in the portfolio site: The 16px slide on hover, press and opening takes `motion/duration/base` with `motion/easing/out`, the same as the Work list's projects
- [Thumbs](components/thumbs.md) in the portfolio site: Under 480px a name too long for its card wraps instead of staying on one line
